subject: Re-audit and correction of FFmpeg neural-media current-host evidence semantics
findings_corrected: reference T7910 CPU/machine tuple was incorrectly enforced by production runtime instead of being non-normative evidence
custom fa3.hrb-placement-receipt.v1 was weaker than the canonical AcceleratorExecutionLease@1 plus broker validation already used by FA3
GPU media fields proved command intent for decoder/filter/encoder rather than observed runtime execution
synthetic Identity ONNX plus synthetic A/V smoke was labelled too broadly as neural-media E2E PASS
FFmpeg build-trust v1 allowed self-asserted signature_verified without verifier identity, SBOM and provenance attestation linkage
codec/container/stream validation and execution evidence provenance chain were incomplete
CPU discovery used online CPUs without making effective process/cgroup affinity a first-class input
mandatory_corrections: FA3-HARDWARE-BASELINE-001 and FA3-HARDWARE-DISCOVERY-CONTRACTS-001 govern portable hardware admission
no concrete CPU/GPU/machine model is a production admission constant
current-host machine identity is evidence-only and non-normative
canonical HRB AcceleratorExecutionLease@1 plus broker VALID proof is required
GPU UUID plus PCI BDF remains canonical accelerator identity and CUDA ordinal is ephemeral
FFmpeg execution-conformance smoke requires requested-versus-observed CUDA ONNX provider and observed decoder/filter/NVENC log evidence
build trust v2 requires stable identity, observed version match, signature verifier identity, SBOM and provenance hashes
synthetic Identity ONNX and synthetic A/V can only prove execution conformance, never production neural-media E2E
production runtime promotion separately requires real or curated media plus admitted neural model identity/hash/license/provenance and task-specific QA
stable FFmpeg 9.0.1 DNN zero-copy remains unclaimed
component conformance PASS cannot promote profile runtime or global FA3
